review_candidates.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time: Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante. Seu Cardápio Diário: Projetar, desenvolver e manter serviços backend em escala para iFood Pago Benefícios rodando na AWS com Kubernetes EKS; Aplicar arquitetura hexagonal ports and adapters SOLID design patterns e princípios de Clean Code em entregas de ponta a ponta; Implementar APIs REST documentadas com OpenAPI Swagger e garantir comunicação segura via TLS mTLS; Projetar integrações event driven usando Kafka AWS MSK ou Kinesis e modelagem de dados em SQL e NoSQL para alta disponibilidade; Entregar qualidade por meio de TDD e pipelines de testes automatizados unitários integração e2e além de participar ativamente de code reviews; Construir observabilidade e operação com OpenTelemetry Prometheus criação de dashboards alerts e respostas a incidents incluindo post mortem; Aplicar padrões de resiliência como circuit breaker health checks self healing e exponential backoff além de estratégias de deployment e automação em CI CD; Usar ferramentas de IA generativa e LLMs para acelerar desenvolvimento automação e revisão de código mantendo mentalidade IA First; Assumir ownership de serviços críticos melhorar resiliência e observability propor e documentar decisões técnicas em RFCs ou ADRs; Entregar onboarding técnico e primeiras features dentro dos primeiros seis meses assumir responsabilidades claras e elevar o padrão técnico do time Ingredientes Que Buscamos: Domínio em ao menos uma stack backend Java 17 Spring Boot Kotlin Spring Boot Ktor ou Go Conhecimento sólido em arquitetura hexagonal ports and adapters SOLID design patterns e Clean Code Experiência com cloud native na AWS e orquestração em Kubernetes EKS Habilidade com padrões de resiliência observability e operação para sistemas de alta disponibilidade Capacidade de projetar e integrar arquiteturas event driven usando Kafka AWS MSK ou Kinesis Familiaridade com bancos SQL Oracle ou PostgreSQL e NoSQL Redis ou MongoDB incluindo modelagem e otimização de queries Práticas sólidas de qualidade de código incluindo TDD testes automatizados code review e CI CD Instrumentação e monitoramento com OpenTelemetry Prometheus e uso de Sentry ou Datadog para rastreamento de erros e performance Mentalidade IA First foco em produtos data driven autonomia mentalidade de dono comunicação direta e priorização 80 20 Habilidade para decompor problemas complexos transformar requisitos de negócio em entregas de alto impacto e comunicar decisões técnicas a múltiplas audiências Para Realçar o Sabor: Experiência com IA e machine learning. Familiaridade com arquiteturas de agentes e AI Workflow incluindo LangGraph OpenAI Agents SDK CrewAI Conhecimento em RAG MCP e orquestração de agentes para soluções IA Native Experiência com ferramentas de IA generativa como Claude Sonnet Gemini Cursor Claude Code Copilot Windsurf Domínio em Go como diferencial adicional Conhecimento do domínio de pagamentos gateways adquirência emissor e plataformas de benefícios SVA Práticas avançadas de deployment blue green canary e automação de release Infra as code e tooling Terraform Dockerfile Helm e administração Linux Otimização de performance em nuvem tuning de aplicações para melhor custo e latência Buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por tecnologia e inovação, que esteja sempre em busca de novos aprendizados e que goste de desafios. Se você se identifica com este perfil, adoraríamos conhecer você! Ref. 52447

review_candidates.title: Full Stack Engineer for NN's Internal Developer Portal
review_candidates.description: At NN, we want engineers to spend less time figuring out how to get things done and more time delivering great software. Our guiding idea is simple: make good things easy, and bad things hard. In both the code we build and the experience we create for the people using our platform. We are looking for a talented Full Stack Engineer for our Internal Developer Portals DX team to help make that happen. Could this be you? Read on to see if you think this is a match. What you are going to do Work closely with engineering teams contributing to Zelda, NN’s Internal Developer Portal, built on the open-source Backstage framework Understand the needs of engineering teams, support their contributions and help them meet their own product goals and deadlines Combine hands-on engineering with close collaboration across teams Improve the portal and the contribution experience by building platform components and scaffolding, writing linting rules and shaping API integration patterns with the right authorisation Strengthen CI/CD processes and automated testing Work with a tech stack that includes AWS, Kubernetes, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Postgres and OpenSearch Streamline inner source contributions by gathering feedback, triaging bugs and prioritising pull requests, while helping teams keep their own product delivery unblocked Keep teams aligned through shared channels, ensuring that questions, decisions and knowledge are transparently shared with everyone involved Help shape how we use AI coding agents by improving the guidance, workflows and tools used by both contributors and the agents they work with What we offer you NN invests in an inclusive, inspiring work environment and in skills and competences for the future. We match this with employee benefits that are in line with what is needed today and in the future. This way, we offer our employees the opportunity to get the best out of themselves. We offer you: Salary between €5,030 and €6,707 based on a 40-hour working week depending on your knowledge and experience 13th month and holiday allowance are paid with your monthly salary 27 vacation days for a 5-day working week and 3 Diversity Days A modern pension administered by BeFrank Plenty of training and learning opportunities NS Business Card 2nd class, which gives you unlimited travel, also privately. Do you prefer to travel with your own transport? Then you can declare the kilometres travelled Allowances for setting up your home office and for internet use Who you are You are a full stack engineer with a strong customer mindset and care about the experience of the people using and contributing to the products you build You are comfortable balancing technical quality with real-world user and contributor needs You bring at least 6 years of engineering experience, including experience with TypeScript, Node.js and React You have an interest in platform engineering and are keen to work with Backstage, APIs and authorisation, cloud technologies, CI/CD, scaffolding and automated testing You communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating across different teams You are able to turn feedback into practical improvements You are eager to learn, do not expect to know everything from day one and actively share what you discover Who you will work with You’ll join the Zelda team within NN’s Engineering Experience & Platforms department. We’ve adopted Marty Cagan’s “No Asshole” rule: we’re looking for people who are good at what they do, and nice to work with. You’ll collaborate with teams across NN, including ServiceNow, Andromeda (Container as a Service) and Asgard (Managed API Gateway), as well as colleagues in architecture and security. Together, you’ll help improve how teams build, contribute to and deliver on our platforms. Will you be our new colleague? We value the knowledge and expertise you bring. We believe that your commitment can take our organization to a higher level. That is why we would like to get to know you. Any questions? Do you have any questions about the job or the procedure? Please contact Liselotte van der Zeeuw – Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist Tech & Data via liselotte.van.der.zeeuw@nn-group.com. We bieden je NS Business card, ook privé te gebruiken 27 vakantiedagen en 3 Diversiteitsdagen 13e maand en vakantiegeld Hybride werken
